description: COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by Facility is published by U.S. Department of Health & Human Services. The dataset records weekly facility-level hospital capacity, occupancy and COVID-19 patient measures. Its stated coverage is United States; hospital-level weekly reports through May 2024. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain U.S. Government. The provider stopped updates after 3 May 2024; retain as an archived series. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
